shortDescription: Search for remote images using podman

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to C(podman) executable if it is not in the C($PATH) on the machine running C(podman)

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit the number of image results returned from the search (per image registry)

options.name: list_tags
options.description: Whether or not to return the list of tags associated with each image

options.name: term
options.description: The search term to look for. Will search all default registries unless a registry is defined in the search term.
